name: Surf Bay Holiday Park
stayType: Family-run holiday park with apartments and caravans
accommodation: Self-catering apartments sleeping 4-6 (2 and 3 bedrooms), plus static caravans
suitableFor: Families, small groups and dog owners
parking: Ample parking alongside each caravan or apartment
beachAccess: Own access to Westward Ho! beach, the Burrows and Pebble Ridge; village centre about a 5-minute walk
confirmedFeatures: Laundry, free WiFi, landscaped lawns, smart TVs, Bluetooth sound systems, some units with hot tubs or jacuzzi baths
overview: A family-run park on the edge of Westward Ho! with its own access onto the beach, Northam Burrows and the Pebble Ridge. Guests stay in self-catering apartments for four to six people or in static caravans, with parking beside each unit and the village shops and pubs about five minutes away on foot.
surfTripFit: Direct access to the beach means you can check the surf and paddle out without moving the car, and parking by the door makes unloading boards simple.
